question: settlement amount kam aaya, how do i see what got deducted

**Report ke columns aur deductions:**
- `amount`: Customer ne kitna pay kiya [1].
- `fee`: Kuberix fee [1].
- `gst`: Fee par GST [1].
- `refunds`: Is settlement se liye gaye refunds (refunds par koi fee nahi hai, par original fee wapas nahi milti) [1][3].
- `chargebacks`: Chargeback amounts held ya deducted [1] (hāra gaye chargeback par ₹250 chargeback handling fee lagti hai) [3].
- `adjustments`: Rentals aur doosre charges, jaise Soundbox rental ₹125 per month [1][2][3].
- `net_settled`: Aapke bank me kitna paisa aaya (`net_settled = amount − fee − gst − refunds − chargebacks − adjustments`) [1].

Agar phir bhi match na ho, toh **Help > Settlement issue** se UTR ke sath ticket raise karein [1].
